title: Peggy’s Cove Small Group Sunset Tour from Halifax
includes: Narrated Tour of Downtown Halifax From a Local Guide
(Pass By) Pier 21 and Point Pleasant Park
Complimentary hotel pick up and drop off in Downtown Halifax
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the Peggy’s Cove Sunset Tour with See Sight Tours—Halifax’s top small-group tour (max 7 guests). Enjoy hotel pickup and drop-off as our expert local guide takes you to Peggy’s Cove to witness a stunning sunset by the iconic lighthouse. Then, relax on a narrated drive through downtown Halifax, passing key landmarks like Pier 21 and Point Pleasant Park, all beautifully lit up after dark.
